## `31a4112b4151` — clipped-target selection family

The canonical default remains exact. The alternative extracts the anchored prototype offsets, evaluates those offsets at every color-9 target, selects the destinations that would clip, and stamps only that input-derived subset. Every generated pair contains two clipped and two unclipped targets; the retained two-demo lesson includes two distinct clipped destinations, which blocks the first-clipped-only shortcut. The four-query bank ends with a distributed 30×30 case and a 5–6-cell prototype.

A first staged run exposed an existing test portability defect: it assumed canonical data lived at a source-tree-relative path. The test now uses `reviewer_support.find_root` and `canonical_path`; the final staged suite passes 47/47. The production generator itself was not changed.
